+- 01M21AEPX6A1KRH0TQ0D4QV9CP

+title: 'ThreadMinimapView: scrubbable rail of turns, tool calls, and errors (plan §9 A)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/ThreadMinimapView.swift`, per plan.md §9 A.
+
+- A thin vertical rail beside the conversation. One tick per item, colored by kind (user, assistant, reasoning, tool call by status, error). The current viewport is a translucent band computed from `ScrollAnchorManager.visibleIDs`.
+- Click or drag on the rail scrolls the conversation to the item under the pointer, through `ScrollViewProxy`.
+- Hidden below a configurable item count and when the window is narrow.
+- Accessibility: the rail is one element with a value "Item N of M", and an adjustable action that steps items.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Twenty items produce twenty ticks with the kind colors.
+- [ ] A click at the middle of the rail scrolls to the middle item (verify the anchor id).
+- [ ] The band follows `visibleIDs`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Thread/ThreadMinimapViewHostedTests.swift`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
